subject: Control gap scan & SIG/CAIQ coordination for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP checks
messages:
From: Peter Lowry <peter.lowry@vendorsec.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG/CAIQ + ISO scope questions ahead of control scan

Jonas / Marissa / Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme is starting a proactive vendor control gap scan to feed our upcoming procurement gate and we need a few things quickly to scope the assessment:  

- Can you confirm current ISO 27001 scope (services/regions) and whether Redwood is planning any scope expansions in the next 6 months?
- Do you have a recent SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) we can reference? If not, is a SOC 2 Type I available?
- Attached is our SIG/CAIQ workbook — please fill tabs A (owner mapping) and B (evidence pointers) where possible.

We also want to understand FedRAMP readiness posture at a high level: any timelines for FedRAMP ATO pursuit or controls in flight that would impact our regulatory mapping?

Prefer a short reply with owners for the SIG tabs and a pointer to the SOC 2 (or expected delivery date). If helpful we can kick off a 30-min sync next week.

(attachment: SIG-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx))

Thanks,
Peter
Peter Lowry
Senior Security Analyst, Acme Procurement
Acme Corp

--

On Fri, May 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Peter Lowry <peter.lowry@vendorsec.com> wrote:
> Sending the SIG/CAIQ workbook and high-level asks so you have them in-line for the scan.
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Peter Lowry <peter.lowry@vendorsec.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ + ISO scope questions ahead of control scan

Peter,

Appreciate the heads up and the workbook. Quick answers up front:
- ISO 27001 scope: Production inference service (hosted API) and Console components in us-west and eu-west regions. No planned scope expansion in the next 3 months; evaluating APAC region in Q3 but not finalized.
- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2025-11-30. I will share the report via drive link with redactions as needed.
- FedRAMP: We are tracking requirements and have a program-level roadmap, but not actively pursuing ATO in the next 6 months. We do have a prioritized control backlog (network segmentation, CSP boundary hardening) that customers sometimes ask about.

Action plan I propose:
1) We will populate the attached control-matrix-template and return a filled SIG tab with owners for high-risk controls by EOD Tue (2026-05-18).
2) Marissa will surface SOC 2 redacted report and a short summary doc.
3) Mina will own evidence staging for anything the Acme team requests (network diagrams, retention policies, KMS attestations).

Do you prefer the evidence links posted to the Drive folder or shared over DocuSign/secure upload?

I'll attach the control mapping template now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
(attachment: control-matrix-template.xlsx (xlsx))
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Peter Lowry <peter.lowry@vendorsec.com>, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ + ISO scope questions ahead of control scan

Peter — following up on Jonas's plan. A few specifics to set expectations:  

- Owners & deadlines: I will own SIG tab A mapping for the core production controls and deliver by COB Tue (2026-05-18). Mina will upload initial evidence pointers to the Drive (control document paths, diagram names).
- SOC 2 link: I will post a redacted SOC 2 Type II to the shared Drive and provide a short memo that lists the testing window and any carve-outs (expected by Tue morning).
- Evidence format: Drive links are fine; for any high-sensitivity artifacts we will provide time-limited access and watermark files. If Acme requires transfer to a secure portal, please advise and we will coordinate.

Open questions for Acme (to clarify scope of the scan):
1) Do you want historical evidence (12 months) or a sampling window (last 90 days)?
2) Are there specific FedRAMP controls you want pre-mapped to the SIG rows? We can prioritize those.

Proposed cadence: quick 30-min sync on Wed 2026-05-20 to review the filled template and walk the evidence links. Please confirm preferred time slots.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Peter Lowry <peter.lowry@vendorsec.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG/CAIQ + ISO scope questions ahead of control scan

Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks — that sounds good. A couple quick clarifications from Acme:  
- Evidence window: sampling is fine — please provide items from the last 90 days when available. If a required control needs a 12-month window we will flag it.
- FedRAMP pre-mapping: yes, please prioritize NIST SP 800-53 controls that commonly map to FedRAMP Low/Moderate. A shortlist is sufficient for our initial scan.
- Secure delivery: Drive with time-limited access works. For SOC 2 we will accept a redacted PDF; please include the testing period in the memo.

We are available Wed 2026-05-20 at 10:00 AM PT for the sync. I will send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will help our procurement review.

Peter
Peter Lowry
Senior Security Analyst, Acme Procurement
